summary: Angelina NF steel lookout in Angelina County, TX; described in a 1949 federal survey and photographed in 1950 and 1959; indexed as gone, with no removal date or site description found.

facts.design: Four-legged steel tower with a glass cab mounted on top
facts.status_note: Forest Fire Lookout Association index marks it Tower Gone; no removal date or description of the site today found

notes_for_editor: Brief record lacked a height; the 1949 survey description gives about 110 ft overall (33.5 m), so height_m was added. Kimmey is the Forest Fire Lookout Association's parenthetical; no source we read explains it. No build date, removal date, staffing beyond the 1950 site description, or fire history found; the story leaves those out. Two SFA ScholarWorks photo records are cited for their descriptions; no direct image URL was recorded, so no photos entry. Sam Rayburn Reservoir is named only as the record's description of the 1959 view. Budget: 2 WebSearch calls and about 6 page reads, with the state index pages shared across the three towers.
